response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something peculiar. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a grand, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly! That is precisely the point. We must break free from the shackles of tradition and forge a new path. A path that is... (he gestures grandly)...vaporwave.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers and advisors, begins to unveil his vision. The room is filled with an assortment of strange and wondrous objects: a fog machine, a fog-colored tapestry, and a collection of vintage VHS tapes.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We shall adorn our castles with neon lights, our banners with pixelated designs, and our armor with... (he consults a nearby scroll)...with "glitch" patterns.

COURTIER 1 (she)
Your Majesty, are you quite sure this is wise?

KING
(firmly)
I am certain. We must adapt to the changing times. The world is moving towards... (he consults another scroll)...towards "retro-futurism."

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is transformed. Knights ride by on hoverbikes, while merchants peddle their wares on hoverboards. The king, resplendent in a neon-lit suit, rides by on a hoverbike, surrounded by his courtiers.

KING
(to his courtiers)
Behold! Our empire is now a beacon of... (he searches for the right words)...of "cyber-romanticism."

COURTIER 2 (he)
Your Majesty, it's... it's quite something.

KING
(smiling)
I know, I know. It's a bold new direction. But trust me, my friends. This is the future.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S CHAMBERS - DAY

The king, surrounded by his advisors, sits in front of a computer screen displaying a never-ending loop of VHS tapes.

KING
(to his advisors)
We must harness the power of... (he consults a nearby scroll)...of "VHS nostalgia."

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, isn't that just... (he searches for the right words)...a bit... retro?

KING
(laughing)
Ah, but that is the beauty of it! We are embracing the past, while forging a new path. A path that is... (he gestures grandly)...vaporwave.

FADE TO BLACK.
